items.actClause:
AN ACT to provide procedures relating to the adoption and submission of an
annual budget by the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the town of
Southampton
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S3715

SPONSOR: LAVALLE
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to provide procedures relating to the adoption and submission of
an annual budget by the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of
the town of Southampton

 
PURPOSE:

To provide procedures relating to the adoption and submission of an
annual budget by the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the
Town of Southampton.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1. Provides a procedure relating to the adoption and submission
of an annual budget by the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of
the Town of Southampton.

Section 2. Effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Provides that the Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the Town
of Southampton shall, after a public hearing, prepare and adopt an annu-
al budget prescribed in section 181 of the Town Law provided that such
annual budget shall not contain an increase of more than two percent
above the budgeted amount of the prior year. The budgetary controls set
forth in section 181-a of the town law and the independent audit
requirements of section 181-b of the town law shall apply to this proce-
dure.

The Trustees of the Freeholders and Commonalty of the Town of Southamp-
ton shall submit their budget on or before the twentieth of September to
the budget officer of the Town of Southampton. The budget format shall
follow that prescribed in section 107 of the town law.

The Town of Southampton budget officer shall affix such budget to the
annual town budget, submitted by the Trustees of the Freeholders and
Commonalty of the town of Southampton.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

2018 S.8659B/A.10677B

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately and shall apply to all fiscal
years beginning on and after January 1, 2021.
